Package teilchen.constraint

Class TriangleCollider

java.lang.Object
teilchen.constraint.Collider
teilchen.constraint.TriangleCollider
All Implemented Interfaces:
Constraint
public class TriangleCollider extends Collider
keeps particles from passing through a triangle. the triangle is two-sided, particles are deflected on the side they come from. particle radius is taken into account.

for many triangles use TriangleMeshCollider, which is considerably faster.
